answer:
The OpenAI-compatible endpoint that lets apps stream speech audio generated by Ollama on macOS is `/v1/audio/speech`. This is mentioned in two places:

1. In the context of the speech capabilities section, it states: "and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint." [ollama/docs/capabilities/speech.md (lines 56-112)].

2. Further, in the API compatibility documentation, the endpoint is described as: "Generates audio with [speech models](/capabilities/speech). The response streams while audio is generated." [ollama/docs/api/openai-compatibility.md (lines 318-335)]. 

These references confirm that `/v1/audio/speech` is the endpoint used for streaming speech audio.
